stories.summary: Martha Firestone Ford, the tire heiress who became a link between two of the automotive industry’s most iconic families and later took over the NFL’s Detroit Lions, has died. She was 101. The Lions say she died Tuesday at her home in Grosse Pointe, Michigan, surrounded by family.
